scope_note: Scope: 269 of 283 equity-sector symbols scored; 14 further equity-sector symbols are LTP-only and are listed as unscored, not dropped (Hydropower 9, Manufacturing And Processing 4, Others 1).

methodology.construction: For each window (calendar days), a stock's return_ is its close-to-close return from the last close on or before (asof - days) to the as-of close. sector_return is the return of the stock's derived equal-weight sector index over the identical window — the same sector returns the Sector Price Rotation board publishes. rel_return = return_ - sector_return, in percentage points.
methodology.identity: rel_return = return_ - sector_return on every row; check any row by subtraction.
methodology.sector_basis: Sector indices are equal-weight composites of current constituents (the site's derived sector series), not official cap-weighted sub-indices. Our taxonomy has 11 sectors; Trading stocks sit inside Others.
methodology.stability: Relation stability is measured history, not a forecast: weekly snapshots over the trailing three years, each board recomputed 28 calendar days later.
methodology.coverage: Rows are the keystone sector constituents with a close on both sides of the window; the rest are listed per window as unscored rather than dropped silently. Equity-sector symbols classified by the site classifier but absent from the keystone because only LTP data exists for them are listed as unscored on every window with reason LTP-only (see scope_note).
